This pursuit unlocks discoveries drawn from your research into the occult. Each time you gain a new discovery, you may take one of the following instead, listed alphabetically.

Arcane Membrane. You have advantage on Intelligence (Lore) or Intelligence (Nature) checks.

Evil Eye (5th level required). Once between long rests, you can cast bestow curse or remove curse without spending force points, using Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) as your forcecasting modifier for them.

Exsanguination (9th level required). When a creature bearing your Curse of Objurgation drops to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction and a Hit Die to immediately regain a use of that curse.

Hexes and Superstitions. Any ability check where the d20 comes up 13 is treated as though it rolled a 20.

Natural Karma. Before cursing a target you can see with a maneuver or power, you may make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check opposed by its Wisdom (Insight); winning keeps the target unaware you cursed it.

Savage Sortilege (13th level required). Your psychic damage ignores resistance, and you yourself have resistance to psychic damage.

Supernatural Vigor. At the end of a long rest, you may imbue one creature within 30 feet (yourself included) with unnatural strength: its hit point maximum and current hit points rise by your scholar level, and it gains advantage on Constitution saves against exhaustion. Both benefits fade after 8 hours.
